dct_description_sm: These files provide the underlying data for Chapter 2 of an MSc thesis assessing Naïo Orio autonomous robot weed management in vegetable crops in the Holland Marsh (Ontario, Canada). In 2024, robot and tractor systems were compared in carrots and table beets on muck and mineral soils. Weed pressure was measured in 0.25 m² quadrats (density, fresh biomass, vegetative cover) with species counts to describe community composition. Crop yield was harvested from standardized subsamples and graded into market classes based on root diameter, generating marketable and total yield metrics (counts, weights, t/ha) and proportional size distributions. A 2025 observational carrot trial evaluates banded herbicide application settings for the Orio robot, including pre/post weed metrics, crop injury, and yield outcomes.

This submission includes four CSV datasets supporting Chapter 2 of an MSc thesis evaluating the performance of the Naïo Orio autonomous robot for vegetable weed management. (1) 2024 carrot yield grading and marketability metrics comparing robot vs tractor across soil types. (2) 2024 table beet yield grading and marketability metrics comparing robot vs tractor across soil types. (3) 2024 weed assessment dataset with quadrat-level weed density, biomass, vegetative cover, and weed species counts across crops, sampling dates, soils, and weed control systems. (4) 2025 observational carrot trial assessing robot-banded herbicide application settings with pre/post weed metrics, crop injury, and yield/marketability variables. Together, the files enable analysis of weed suppression and crop yield outcomes under autonomous vs conventional management.
dct_title_s: Naïo Orio autonomous robot evaluation for weed management data in carrots and table beets in the Holland Marsh, Ontario, 2024 and 2025
